content: Dewitdi saŋiniŋ moŋgotdok nadiŋa haniŋ ninadi kwanai tuguk
Yahwe, memikneye fee hinek mintaaŋ nehitubu-kadakaiŋ.
Tiŋa indiŋ naniiŋ, “Bepaŋ adi tuwot mu gehitubu-lodawek.”

Iŋgoŋ oŋ, medehik wendi folooŋ mu tilak. Yahwe, du kubugoŋdi mik diniŋ kweletalak unduŋ tiŋa yahenamulaŋ. Du kubugoŋdi nehitubu-lodaune yalakapmeŋ tilat. Du kubugoŋdi welemulapne ulatifooŋ nehitubu-lodaune saŋiniŋnit yatat.
Nu Yahwedi nehitubu-lodadok kutiniŋgut. Kaŋ ne’walaŋ kweboboe uŋgoniŋ foloŋ haliŋa kutikutine nadiŋa nehitubu-lodaguk.
Nu adi damo deila agaŋ deikauleeŋ hakut. Iŋgoŋ oŋ, Yahwedi nabudokolak doktiŋa kotigoŋ sukuleeŋ pilali hatilat.
Memik 10 tausen unduŋdi nehi-kelemadidapmaiŋ, iŋgoŋ nu aditok munta mu tibit.
Yahwe, du beŋ. Bepaŋne, du buŋa nehitubu-lodaweŋ. Du memik tinamiiŋ mahik geŋ foloŋ kisaŋ hinek widihiŋa yehitubu-mekalaŋ, tiŋa me hogohi’walaŋ mahik kitili ugolokuyemulaŋ.
Yahwe, du kubugoŋdi unduŋ tiŋa kotigoŋ ninigitaŋ kaŋ nemek niŋdi nemu nihitubu-kadakalak. Du’walaŋ kahaŋgedi metamgeye foloŋ haliwooŋ halaak.
